news.title: Solstice Minerals CEO speaks with Proactive at the ASX SMIDcaps Conference
news.summary: Solstice Minerals (ASX:SLS) CEO Nick Castleden talked with Proactive at the ASX Small and Mid-Cap Conference about the company’s flagship Nanadie Copper-Gold Project. Solstice is a copper and gold explorer led by chairman Matthew Yates and managing director and CEO Nick Castleden, whose team brings broad experience spanning grassroots exploration through to mine development and operations. The company’s flagship Nanadie Copper-Gold Project in Western Australia hosts a JORC-compliant inferred resource of 40.4 million tonnes at 0.4% copper and 0.1 g/t gold, containing 162,000 tonnes of copper and 130,000 ounces of gold. Recent drilling has highlighted the project’s growth potential, including a 629-metre intersection grading 0.50% copper and 0.17 g/t gold in hole NANRCD004. Solstice also holds more than 1,500 square kilometres of licences and applications across the Eastern Goldfields, including the Yarri and Ringlock projects, which provide additional exposure to gold and nickel sulphide exploration. #SolsticeMineralsLimited #ProactiveInvestors #NickCastleden #GoldExploration #MineralExploration

General Assembly in New York following his threat during an address to the annual gathering that the U.S. might “annihilate” the Islamic Republic if a deal couldn’t be made.  “Will a deal be made with Iran that lets them rebuild and create a far greater country than it ever was before, maybe one of the greatest in the Middle East or even the world,” Trump said.
